description: This file defines the SNActionsService class, which manages action-based extensions, including loading extensions, executing actions (render, show, post), decrypting payloads, and handling related interactions within a note-taking or encryption app.

classes.name: SNActionsService
classes.description: A service class managing action-based extensions, including loading, executing, and decrypting payloads, with methods for handling different action types and extension interactions.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and resets internal state.

methods.name: addPayloadRequestHandler
methods.description: Adds a handler for outgoing payload requests, returning a function to remove it.

methods.name: extensionsInContextOfItem
methods.description: Filters extensions applicable to a specific item based on supported types or context actions.

methods.name: loadExtensionInContextOfItem
methods.description: Loads an extension in the context of a specific item, fetching data from a remote URL.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes a specified action (render, show, post) on an item.

methods.name: handleRenderAction
methods.description: Handles 'render' actions by fetching and decrypting remote data.

methods.name: payloadByDecryptingResponse
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt a response payload using various keys and prompts for passwords if needed.

methods.name: promptForLegacyPassword
methods.description: Prompts the user for a password to decrypt payloads.

methods.name: handlePostAction
methods.description: Handles 'post' actions by sending item data to a remote URL.

methods.name: handleShowAction
methods.description: Handles 'show' actions by opening a URL in the device's browser.

methods.name: outgoingPayloadForItem
methods.description: Prepares the payload for outgoing data, encrypting if necessary.

methods.name: getPayloadFromRequestHandlers
methods.description: Retrieves a payload from registered request handlers based on item UUID.
